contract.owner_isolation: unregister() does not remove a callback registered under a different plugin owner
contract.callback_isolation: unregister() does not remove a different callback belonging to the same event
contract.failed_unregister_integrity: Failed unregister operations leave the listener registry unchanged
contract.failed_unregister_delivery: Callbacks remain active after unrelated failed unregister attempts
contract.targeted_removal: Successful unregister removes only the matching plugin/event/callback registration
contract.remaining_callbacks: Other callbacks remain active after targeted removal
contract.repeated_unregister: Unregistering an already removed registration returns false
contract.registry_cleanup: All targeted registrations can subsequently be removed without registry corruption
contract.delivery_order: Remaining callbacks preserve registry delivery order
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful throughout unregister isolation scenarios
contract.permission_enforcement: EventBus unregister operations require the events permission
